# Itqan Studio

> Itqan Studio is a Dubai-based design, automation and AI agency. It builds brand identity, UI/UX and web design, custom web/app development, and agentic AI automation systems for ambitious founders — taking companies "from invisible to inevitable in 90 days." "Itqan" (إتقان) is Arabic for mastery/excellence.

Itqan Studio (legal name: Itqan Studio FZ LLC) operates from Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and serves clients across the UAE, the GCC, and globally. It is a "founder studio": brand, operating system, and automation are designed and shipped as one connected system rather than as disconnected deliverables. The studio works in English and Arabic. Contact: info@itqanstudio.com.

## What Itqan Studio does (services)
- Brand Identity & Strategy: brand strategy, naming, positioning, and full visual identity systems.
- UI/UX & Web Design: research-led product, platform, and website design.
- Web & App Development: custom, full-stack web and application development.
- AI & Agentic Automation: agentic automation engines for lead capture, content, and reporting — controllable from Telegram.

## Selected case studies
- [Mutqin](https://itqanstudio.com/work/mutqin): Itqan's own live AI startup companion — brand, character, and full-stack product (mutqin.xyz).
- [Nexilink](https://itqanstudio.com/work/nexilink): brand + investor-ready product UX delivered in 3 weeks; the client placed first at a 2024 investor competition.
- [Shareefico](https://itqanstudio.com/work/shareefico): personal brand + custom CMS + content-automation engine (shareefi.co).
- [Project You](https://itqanstudio.com/work/project-you): a calm, faith-rooted life-OS SaaS with a verse-by-verse Qur'an companion (projectyou.app).
- [Oud Closet](https://itqanstudio.com/work/oud-closet): luxury modest-fashion brand identity + bespoke Shopify storefront (oudcloset.se).
- [Medacs](https://itqanstudio.com/work/medacs): multi-stakeholder healthcare platform UX, validated and dev-ready in 2 weeks.
- [Itqan Studio CRM](https://itqanstudio.com/work/itqan-crm): the studio's own operations platform with UAE-compliant e-invoicing.
